<!-- pr-reviewer: c3ccdd218b2cdb3e27dc0990509e5e2de3ee6cf2 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** One gap: a rerun with `--failed` does not run the skipped steps.

## What looks good
- Exit code: the failed build step stays in `done` with `ok=false`, so `bad >= 1` and the gate exits red. The `SKIP` rows are printed only, so they cannot make the gate green. A stalled build also stops the plan.
- Scope: the stop runs only in the one-at-a-time loop (`exec.rs:187-203`). Batch and release lanes (`run_lanes`) and the quick fallback to the batch plan are unchanged. The step-name match (`build_stop::stops`) hits only `debug build (--no-run)` and the quick per-crate step `<crate> build (--no-run)` (`quick.rs:355`). Other build names do not match: `debug build: <crate> (--no-run)`, `heavy build (release --no-run)`, `light build (release --no-run)`. A test step name cannot end in ` build (--no-run)`.
- The package for `cargo clean -p` comes from the first `-p` of the step args, not from the log. The crate name from the log is only printed. No shell injection.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic` on the gate path. `plan.steps[i + 1..]` is safe.
- Process rules: `Process change: yes` is in the body; `PROCESS_VERSION` is not edited; `Changelog: none`; `Refs #3601`; decision file present; new files are 50 and 84 lines; `exec.rs` is 393 lines.
- The skill paragraph agrees with the code (names, `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=4`, no retry, no clean).

## Results merged with main
Locally, in a worktree trial-merged with main `2de07141509c367531bc7634fc4324e08c2bce15` (already up to date, no conflict). Not on the runner.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -j 6 -p xtask -- --test-threads=6` | lib 300 passed, 0 failed (the 4 `build_stop_tests` pass); `catalog` 4; `docs_images` 4; `example_line_endings` 3; `merge_ready_skill` 3; `post_merge_concurrency` 2; `post_merge_report` 1; `post_merge_stall` 1; `release_site_tests` 3; `review_artifacts` 3; `lane_verdict` and `merge_review` 0 tests. No failure. |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main --dry-run` | plan prints (1 step: `xtask unit tests`) |

## Heavy lanes
`cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main --dry-run`: the diff reaches no heavy lane.

## Requested before merge
1. `--failed` does not rerun the skipped steps. A skipped step has no log file, and `select::failed_stems` (`xtask/src/select.rs:30-43`) lists only steps with a failed log. After a build stop, `cargo xtask gate quick --failed gate-logs/<run>` runs only the build step. When that build passes, the rerun is green and the suites were never run. Before this PR, the later steps ran, failed, and had logs, so `--failed` found them. Fix it in one of these ways: (a) write a log for each skipped step in `exec.rs` (around line 200) that `log_failed` reads as failed, with the `not run (build failed: <step>)` text; or (b) make `failed_in_dir` also list the steps of the plan that have no log. Add a test: a stop, then `failed_stems` or `failed_in_dir` over the log directory names the skipped steps. Also say in the skill paragraph (`.claude/skills/gate/SKILL.md`, line 54) how to rerun after a stop. Last, state that the `SKIP` rows are not counted in `N step(s)`.

## Notes (not blocking)
- The `BUILD FAULT` block is not limited to a failed build step. `Run::execute` (`exec.rs:295-298`) runs it for every failed step that did not stall, also in the batch and release lanes and for test steps. A failed test whose output quotes `E0786` or `E0460` (for example the `build_stop_tests` assertion text) prints a wrong block that says "the test steps of this build did not run". It only prints; no verdict changes. Consider `stops(&s.name) || s.args.contains(&"--no-run")` as the condition. The PR body says "a failed step", so the text is true, but the skill text says "a build step".
- A step with several `-p` values (`debug build (--no-run)`) gets advice for the first package only. The serial path does not run that step in quick today, so this is minor.
- The `SKIP` rows print after the `done` rows. The `wall ... step(s)` line does not count them. Fine once item 1 is fixed.

The PR stays a draft. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 2250958dd8dcdcd3a37c4bdb66f8e987298a07b4 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** The blocker and the note of the first review are fixed.

## What looks good
- Blocker fixed. After a stop, `build_stop::write_not_run` (`xtask/src/build_stop.rs`) writes one log for each stopped step, with the one line `not run (build failed: <step>)`. `select::log_failed` reads a line that starts with that text as a failed step. So `--failed gate-logs/<run>` selects the build step and each stopped step.
- The log numbers continue the run: the first stopped step gets `done.len() + 1`, the number that `execute` would use next. The names come from `exec::log_name`, so `select::apply` maps each log to its step. The test `quick_plan_stops_after_a_failed_per_crate_build` checks this: `failed_in_dir`, then `apply`, gives the build step and both stopped steps.
- A stalled build also stops the plan and writes the logs (`failed` is `!ok`, and a stall is not ok).
- The exit code stays red. The `SKIP` rows are print-only. `.github/scripts/post-merge-report.sh` counts only `FAIL` and `STALL` rows, so a `SKIP` row is no test failure. Post-merge runs the batch tier, which does not use this path. The light lane note (`rerun_note`) reads `done` only. The light and heavy build names (`light build (release --no-run)`, `heavy build (release --no-run)`) do not match `stops`.
- A test cannot easily match the `not run (build failed:` text at the start of a line: libtest indents or captures output, and a false match only gives an extra rerun, never a false green.
- Note fixed. `metadata_note` now needs `--no-run` in the step args. The new test `a_test_step_that_quotes_a_metadata_error_gives_no_block` pins it.
- The delta in the PR is small: `build_stop.rs`, `build_stop_tests.rs`, `select.rs` (`log_failed`, 7 lines), `exec.rs` (one call), the skill paragraph and the decision file. The skill text says what the code does, including `--failed`. Process rules hold: `PROCESS_VERSION` is not edited, new files are under 400 lines, and the body has `Process change: yes`, `Changelog: none` and `Refs #3601`.

## Results merged with main
Locally, in a worktree trial-merged with main `33685374f97ac8c4a88feb199e62a245e6fd44cd` (clean, no conflict). Not on the runner.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -j 6 -p xtask -- --test-threads=6` | lib 307 passed, 0 failed (the 5 `build_stop_tests` pass); `catalog` 4; `docs_images` 4; `example_line_endings` 3; `merge_ready_skill` 3; `post_merge_concurrency` 2; `post_merge_report` 1; `post_merge_stall` 1; `release_site_tests` 3; `review_artifacts` 3; `lane_verdict` and `merge_review` 0 tests. No failure. |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main --dry-run` | plan prints (1 step: `xtask unit tests`) |

## Heavy lanes
`cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main --dry-run`: the diff reaches no heavy lane.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Notes (not blocking)
- A step with several `-p` values gets the `cargo clean` advice for the first package only. The quick serial path has no such build step.
- The PR is a draft on purpose. The merging session flags it ready.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
